description: DEF CON 33 Bug Bounty Village talks covering modern triage dynamics, AI bug bounty scopes, referral vulnerabilities, and enterprise bounty management.

talks.title: Hacker v. Triage - Inside Bug Bounty Battleground
talks.teaser: Explores the tension between security researchers and vulnerability triagers, detailing strategies to resolve disputes over severity and payouts.

talks.title: Regex For Hackers
talks.teaser: Practical guide to crafting regular expressions that unearth hidden endpoints, parse raw source code, and discover targets automated tools miss.

talks.title: Managing Bug Bounties @ Scale
talks.teaser: Security leaders from Amazon, PayPal, and Shopify share operational playbooks for running mature bug bounty programs at enterprise scale.

talks.title: Designing and Participating in AI Bug Bounty Programs
talks.teaser: Technical deep dives into real-world AI vulnerabilities including prompt injection, context poisoning, and RAG manipulation within bug bounty scopes.

talks.title: Full Disclosure, Full Color: Story of This Year's BBV Badge
talks.teaser: Inside the design and engineering of the Bug Bounty Village badge, combining interactive electronics, multi-layered PCB art, and a hardware CTF.

talks.title: Sometimes you find bugs, sometimes bugs find you
talks.teaser: Case studies of accidental vulnerability discoveries and chaotic edge-cases encountered across years of commercial bug bounty hunting.

talks.title: Referral Beware, Your Rewards Are Mine
talks.teaser: Deep dive into systemic logic flaws and authorization bypasses hidden within commercial referral and reward implementations.

talks.title: Prompt Scan Exploit: AI's Journey Through 0Days and 1000 Bugs
talks.teaser: How an offensive autonomous AI agent discovered over 200 vulnerabilities in open-source projects and submitted over 1,000 bug bounty reports.

talks.title: Back to Basics: Building Resilient Cyber Defenses
talks.teaser: Examines why viral security advice fails to address real risks and provides practical foundational strategies to build durable defenses.
